newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-C.BANK SAYS 2ND REPO AUCTION JUNE 12.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-C.BANK SAYS 2ND REPO AUCTION JUNE 12.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Tuesday it decided to launch its second repurchase (repo) auction on Thursday, June 12.

"The central bank will offer commercial banks T-bills for a maximum sum of 20 million litas, for a seven percent annual interest rate with seven days maturity," Arvydas Kregzhde, the director of the bank's market operations, told Reuters.
The Bank of Lithuania launched its first repo auction last week as part of attempts to regain more of the functions of a central bank of which it was stripped under the currency board.
One commercial bank participated in the first repo auction last week and a deal of 300,000 litas was registered. The maturity of the deal expires on Thursday.
The Bank of Lithuania said earlier it wants to hold the auctions on regular basis but a timetable has not been set.
